listing.name: Pokémon Rumble — RumbleRecomp (ToShredsYouSay)
listing.summary: The beta is reported to support four-player fights at full speed, mainly in NVIDIA tests. Full playthroughs of every version remain unconfirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA WiiWare WPSE01 WAD. WeekendEdition1.5 and PATCH1 patches are optional and require your own permitted copies.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release launcher to compile locally on first play; allow approximately 20–40 minutes. Keep the resulting installed game data.

warnings: The beta is reported to support four-player fights at full speed, mainly in NVIDIA tests. Full playthroughs of every version remain unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
